item.title: Episodes
item.description: Complete broadcast archive and episode backlog for Barely Informed News.

item.title: Gaming
item.description: Live gameplay on the main broadcast by Case Blackwell, in-studio talent and guests, from co-op sessions to game browsing.

item.title: Crum (Leonard Crum)
item.description: Leonard Crum (known on air simply as Crum, occasionally transcribed as Crumb) is a senior debate analyst on Barely Informed News, best known as one half of the network’s premier debate clash, Munch & Crum.

item.title: Kendelle
item.description: Kendelle is lead anchor Case Blackwell’s real-life and in-show girlfriend, making occasional in-studio appearances across Barely Informed News.

item.title: Liliana Breathinschmit
item.description: Liliana Breathinschmit (known on air simply as Liliana) is a recurring in-studio contributor and news desk co-anchor on Barely Informed News.

item.title: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
item.description: Ralph Munchcut (known on air simply as Munch) is a senior debate analyst on Barely Informed News, anchoring the network’s premier political debate clash, Munch & Crum.

item.title: Trip Bradstein
item.description: Trip Bradstein is an eccentric field correspondent for Barely Informed News.

item.title: Amongst the Web
item.description: The audience-interactive viral media review desk on Barely Informed News.

item.title: Munch & Crum
item.description: The flagship political debate desk on Barely Informed News, featuring fiery head-to-head clashes between senior debate analysts Ralph Munchcut and Crum.

item.title: Trip on the Street
item.description: The remote “man on the street” interview desk on Barely Informed News, hosted live on location from the bushes of a public park by field correspondent Trip Bradstein.
